items.description: One music-score asset reference row — a puck.music.v1 document's stable name, its file path (resolved beside the document that authors the row, WorldDocumentPaths), and the SHA-256 hex64 pin of the referenced document's own canonical bytes. Never embedded: the document is loaded, canonicalized, and hash-verified where it is compiled (Server.WorldServer's construction), the same load-then-pin discipline Puck.Text.FontAtlasSourceResolver.ResolvePinned already applies to a font asset.

name.description: The row's stable name — its mutation address.

source.description: The referenced document's file path, relative to the authoring document's directory or absolute.

hash.description: The SHA-256 hex64 of the referenced document's canonical bytes.

items.title: WorldMusicRow
